ui.hero.title: One platform for all the animals you care for
ui.hero.sub: Records, everyday work and team interaction across all your sites. Find any task in Antz — with real screens.
ui.modules.lede: Click any card to open the guide with all the functions and screens.
ui.cta.text: In this guide, for each module the functions are described and real screens are shown. Continue from where you left off, or write to us — we will help.
ui.day.title: How your first day in Antz goes
ui.day.3: Set up the main reference lists
ui.day.4: Give everyone the access they need
ui.day.4.desc: Create roles that correspond to your organization, and turn on permissions by module, so that everyone sees what is needed for their work.
ui.faq.q2: Does the system work on phones and computers?
ui.faq.a2: Yes. The mobile app covers work in the field: notes, treatment, movements and egg records. The web app covers work at a desk: the hospital system, setup of the incubation rooms, reports and pharmacy stock. Updates appear in real time on the phone, tablet and computer.
ui.faq.q3: Is it possible to manage who sees what?
ui.faq.a3: Yes. Access is based on roles. You create the roles adopted in your organization, for example "Zoologist", and turn on permissions by module.
ui.faq.q4: We have several sites. Is this supported?
ui.faq.a4: Antz stores the data of all sites and departments in one place. The keeping of animals is organized by sites, sections and enclosures, and movements between sites go through approval and release by the security service.
ui.faq.a5: Start with the "Getting started" guide, then open the modules that your role uses. If something is unclear, write to hello@antz.systems.

m.necropsy.title: Autopsy
m.necropsy.intro: The "Autopsy" module documents pathological-anatomical examinations with detailed observations, findings by organ and medical conclusions. It ensures accurate analysis of the cause of death, standardizes reporting, timely handling of carcasses and compliance with legal, audit and veterinary requirements.
m.necropsy.f1.title: Search and filters
m.necropsy.f1.desc: Search by animal/species; filters by site, date, priority.
m.necropsy.f2.title: Status tracking
m.necropsy.f3.title: Animal card and request details
m.necropsy.f3.desc: AID, species, location, reason, requester, priority.
m.deworming.title: Deworming
m.deworming.intro: The "Deworming" module ensures systematic recording and monitoring of antiparasitic treatments, timely administration of drugs, proper documentation and clear tracking of every deworming for every animal.
m.deworming.f1.title: Views by status
m.deworming.f1.desc: Deworming is divided into upcoming, pending, missed and completed for convenient monitoring.
m.deworming.f2.title: Deworming management
m.deworming.f2.desc: Schedule a course or immediately record an administered drug with dates and details indicated.
m.deworming.f3.title: Administration record
m.deworming.f3.desc: Records the dosage, batch number, method of administration, notes and, if necessary, a repeat examination.
m.housing.title: Keeping [?]
m.housing.intro: The "Keeping" module arranges animals' places of habitation by sites, sections and enclosures, so that every animal has a known place and every change is tracked. Access at each level is determined by permissions.
m.housing.f1.title: Site management
m.housing.f1.desc: Add and change sites with role-based permissions for safe, orderly access.
m.housing.f2.title: Section management
m.housing.f2.desc: Add and change sections of the zoo with permission-based control for safe administration.
m.housing.f3.title: Enclosure management
m.housing.f3.desc: Add and change enclosures and keep track of each of them for effective control of animals and data.
m.fetal-death.title: Death of the fetus
m.fetal-death.intro: The "Death of the fetus" module records cases of fetal death in enclosures, capturing the cause, time and related animal details. It helps veterinary work, monitoring of reproductive health, analysis of trends and improvement of population management.
m.fetal-death.f1.title: Adding a fetal death record
m.fetal-death.f1.desc: Record new cases: cause, time, parents, animal details.
m.fetal-death.f2.title: Search and filters
m.fetal-death.f2.desc: Search by keyword; filters by site, date, stillbirth or abortion, species or sex.
m.fetal-death.f3.title: Viewing death records
m.fetal-death.f3.desc: Full details: days since death, cause, ID, enclosure, site, sex.
m.egg-management-app.title: Egg management — App
m.egg-management-app.intro: The "Eggs" module tracks the full life cycle of eggs — from laying to hatching or transfer to the incubation room — ensuring accurate records, real-time updates and full traceability for coordinated and accountable work of the nest, incubation room and brood teams.
m.egg-management-app.f1.title: Egg panel
m.egg-management-app.f1.desc: Current data: in nests, transferred to the incubation room, marked for culling.
m.egg-management-app.f2.title: Egg entry (nest / incubation room)
m.egg-management-app.f2.desc: Add eggs with parents, condition, dates, species, notes and attachments.
m.egg-management-app.f3.title: Life cycle tracking
m.egg-management-app.f3.desc: Status, weight and the full chronology of the egg's path.
m.administer-medicine.title: Administration of drugs
m.administer-medicine.intro: The "Administration" module complements medical records, turning prescriptions into practical treatment processes. It makes it possible to provide care in real time to individual animals or groups — in the field or in hospital.
m.administer-medicine.f1.title: Quick entry
m.administer-medicine.f1.desc: Create a record of direct administration for a chosen date without a full medical record.
m.administer-medicine.f2.title: Search and filters
m.administer-medicine.f2.desc: Quickly find records and narrow the list by date, object, species, controlled substance. [?]
m.administer-medicine.f3.title: Status tracking
m.administer-medicine.f3.desc: View treatment by date on four tabs: "Pending", "Administered", "Missed", "Discontinued".
m.vaccination.title: Vaccination
m.vaccination.intro: The "Vaccination" module covers the full cycle of vaccinating animals — from planning and direct administration to tracking upcoming, pending, missed and completed inoculations. It ensures timely treatment, accurate recording of dosage and full traceability for disease prevention and compliance with clinical requirements.
m.vaccination.f1.title: Views by status
m.vaccination.f1.desc: Inoculations are divided into upcoming, pending, missed and completed for convenient monitoring.
m.vaccination.f2.title: Vaccination management
m.vaccination.f2.desc: Schedule a vaccination or immediately record an administered vaccine with dates and drug details indicated.
m.vaccination.f3.title: Administration record
m.vaccination.f3.desc: Records the dosage, batch number, method of administration, notes and, if necessary, a repeat examination.
m.pharmacy-web.title: Pharmacy (Web)
m.pharmacy-web.intro: Ensures fast, accurate and traceable issuing of medical goods directly to authorized doctors, timely fulfillment of requests and automatic updating of stock — from prescription to shelf, with accounting by batch and control of expiry dates at all stages.
m.pharmacy-web.f1.title: Panel
m.pharmacy-web.f1.desc: Real-time data on problems with stock, deliveries, purchases, requests, consumption, expiring dates and fast-moving goods, with visual trends for quick action.
m.pharmacy-web.f2.title: Smart search and filters
m.pharmacy-web.f2.desc: Quickly find records by request ID, doctor's name or pharmacy.
m.pharmacy-web.f3.title: Reference lists (racks and shelves)
m.pharmacy-web.f3.desc: Organize storage by number of racks and shelves for quick access and updating, with customizable data (packaging, units of measurement, active substances, drivers, manufacturers). [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f4.title: Management of stock reports
m.pharmacy-web.f4.desc: Stock by batch with cost and expiry date; marking of running-out and expired items; control of approaching expiry dates; management of depositing with resolution of disputes. [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f5.title: Management of goods and stock
m.pharmacy-web.f5.desc: Create goods, track stock and expiry dates, record purchases and shipments, keep a single accounting book, work with substitutes and variants.
m.pharmacy-web.f6.title: Management of issuing
m.pharmacy-web.f6.desc: Doctors can prescribe and issue drugs or receive them directly at the pharmacy — everything is recorded.
m.pharmacy-web.f7.title: Management of deliveries
m.pharmacy-web.f7.desc: Track incoming and outgoing deliveries of drugs and carry them out in the app.
m.pharmacy-web.f8.title: Stock adjustment and reports
m.pharmacy-web.f8.desc: Record changes in stock (shortage, breakage, expired date); keep an audit history; process returns to suppliers; download reports on consumption, returns, purchases and issuing for finance and demand planning.
m.getting-started.title: Getting started
m.getting-started.intro: The "Getting started" guide explains the purpose of the app and leads new users through the main steps: setting up a profile, getting to know the key functions and navigating the platform effectively.
m.getting-started.f1.title: Access and workspaces
m.getting-started.f1.desc: Log in to the system securely and open the working environment assigned to you.
m.getting-started.f2.title: Navigation and interface
m.getting-started.f2.desc: Use the feed on the main screen for updates, quick-jump shortcuts and the bottom panel for the main tools.
m.getting-started.f3.title: Awaits autopsy / administration / placement
m.getting-started.f3.desc: Animals awaiting autopsy, paperwork, and subsequent placement or disposal until the final closing of records.
m.getting-started.f4.title: Main settings and modules
m.getting-started.f4.desc: Set up the main reference lists and study such modules as "Medical records", "Keeping", "Eggs", "Diet" and "Animal management".
m.getting-started.f5.title: Personalization
m.getting-started.f5.desc: Manage notes, update your profile and set up the language.
m.getting-started.f6.title: Permissions
m.getting-started.f6.desc: Understand the access levels needed for safe work.
